owner_rejection_remediation.details: The design replaces portrait-to-scene assembly with one blank-canvas full-scene generation and forbids reuse of A007 or M03 pixels, plates, crops, edit targets, or start frames.

identity_reference_only.details: A007 supplies identity conditioning only. Face, body, pose, wardrobe, lighting, lens, room and composition must be generated together from scratch.

outfit_lock.details: The complete petrol tailored jumpsuit, brass hardware, earrings, cuff, boots and low ponytail are materially specified and continuity-locked; the rejected ivory blouse is explicitly excluded.

composition_and_coherence.details: Native 9:16 head-to-boot composition defines one camera, one architectural plane, coherent floor contact, shadows, perspective and material response, with explicit anti-collage and anti-CGI constraints.

exact_four_lights_metaphor.initial_state: Exactly four ordinary frosted-glass wall lights, all off, plus one unlabelled brass switch.
exact_four_lights_metaphor.animated_state: Exactly the second light from the bottom turns on once; the other three remain dark.
exact_four_lights_metaphor.details: Fixture count, order, switch count and single-circuit transition are explicit and continuity-locked.

text_ui_and_graphics.details: Prompts ban text, letters, numbers, labels, signage, logos, captions, UI, diagrams, holograms, borders and technical overlays.

cliche_and_tier_dialect.details: The Tier prompt is under 25 words and contains no banned documentary or journalistic modifiers, sensitive document terms, city names, or compound location-style direction.

safety.details: No violence, death, prison, weapon, document, passport, stamp, city-name or other known Veo safety-trigger term appears in the Tier prompt.

camera_and_motion.details: One rigid 50 mm-equivalent tripod take, one measured press, one withdrawal and one hold; camera movement, cuts, morphing and secondary actions are forbidden.

native_audio.details: Audio is restricted to quiet room air and one soft dry synchronized switch click, with speech, music, hum and unrelated ambience banned.

cost.details: This PASS authorizes one keyframe job only. Observe the live debit immediately; fail closed if it exceeds 50 credits. The separate 10-credit video remains unauthorized until the keyframe passes all identity and composition gates.

requirements: Record a fresh keyframe path and SHA-256 with no inherited M03 media pixels.
ArcFace cosine against A007 at least 0.60.
Independent holistic identity PASS with unobstructed near-frontal face.
Independent composition, material and perspective PASS with zero collage, cutout, halo, portrait-card or CGI cue.
Complete Midnight Petrol Column outfit, accessories, ponytail and both boots visible and correct.
Exactly four physical wall lights visible and off, plus one unlabelled physical switch.
Zero visible text, UI, border, reflection, document, logo or additional person.
Bind the measured keyframe Flow debit and confirm at least 10 credits remain inside the owner ceiling for the video.
